stories.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled at UK airports after air traffic control issue
stories.summary: A UK air traffic control issue disrupted operations at airports, leading to hundreds of flight cancellations. The BBC is covering the live situation as passengers face delays across the country.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill 11 people in southern Lebanon
stories.summary: Israeli airstrikes killed at least 11 people in southern Lebanon, according to reports. The strikes add to rising cross-border tensions between Israel and Hezbollah.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes after three-day pause in hostilities
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine traded strikes following a three-day pause in hostilities, ending a brief lull. The exchange underscores the continued intensity of the war despite intermittent ceasefires.

stories.title: Far-right party posts strongest showing in a German election since the Nazi era
stories.summary: A far-right party recorded its strongest result in a German national election since the Nazi era. The outcome signals a major political shift in Germany and across Europe.

stories.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent
stories.summary: Meta introduced Muse, its new AI agent, raising questions about whether consumers will trust it. The launch marks another major consumer-facing AI push from the company.

stories.title: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Images 2.5
stories.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Images 2.5, an upgrade to its image-generation model for ChatGPT. The update is the latest step in the company's push to expand multimodal AI capabilities.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome Atlas, a predictive map of every DNA letter change
stories.summary: Google DeepMind launched AlphaGenome Atlas, a free research platform containing predictions for the effects of 9 billion single-nucleotide variants across the human genome. It is the most comprehensive catalogue yet of how genetic mutations affect molecular biology and aims to accelerate rare-disease and genetic research.

stories.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
stories.summary: French AI startup Mistral raised €3 billion in a round that underscores Europe's push for sovereign, open-weight AI. The funding gives Mistral a larger war chest to compete with US frontier labs.

stories.title: Too optimistic? Browns looking like a 7-10 team in 2026
stories.summary: News-Herald columnist Jeff Schudel argues the Browns are likely headed for a 7-10 record in 2026. He lays out where the roster falls short as the team prepares for the season.

stories.title: A bad day to be a certain backup QB
stories.summary: The daily Browns news roundup highlights a rough day for a backup quarterback, with notes on the quarterback room and roster updates. It collects the latest Browns and NFL news from around the league.

stories.title: Ohio State football press conference: Ryan Day speaks ahead of Texas
stories.summary: Ohio State head coach Ryan Day spoke to the media on Tuesday ahead of the Buckeyes' top-five rematch against Texas this weekend. Day discussed preparation for the road showdown in Austin.

stories.title: Ohio State's Ryan Day previews game against Texas
stories.summary: Ryan Day and team captains previewed Ohio State's Week 2 matchup with No. 4 Texas following the Buckeyes' 56-3 season-opening win over Ball State. The rematch pits the top-ranked Buckeyes against the Longhorns in Austin.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov releases patch 1.1.5.0
stories.summary: Battlestate Games shipped Escape from Tarkov patch 1.1.5.0, a major update. It brings a large-scale Lighthouse rework with Rogues leaving the Water Treatment plant, changes to how Lightkeeper is accessed, and the Icebreaker game mechanic update.

stories.title: Tarkov patch notes feature major Lighthouse overhaul
stories.summary: Analysis of the new Escape from Tarkov patch highlights a massive overhaul of the Lighthouse map, including Rogues relocating and landmines being removed. It is described as the biggest Lighthouse change yet.

stories.title: Columbus man withdraws guilty plea in deadly I-670 road rage shooting
stories.summary: Tony Brock, scheduled to be sentenced Tuesday in connection with a deadly road-rage shooting on I-670 in Columbus, instead withdrew his guilty plea and obtained new counsel. The case involving the 2023 killing of Village Cigars owner Bret Bennett continues.

stories.title: U.S. Marshals find 79 missing children in Ohio during Operation Meridian
stories.summary: The U.S. Marshals Service recovered 79 missing and endangered children across Ohio in Operation Meridian, working with federal, state and local agencies including Columbus police. Authorities call it the largest missing-child operation in state history.
